## What this is

The chat page polls this to find out when a scheduled task has finished, so its answer can be read back into the conversation without anyone having to ask.

It reads finished rows from `schedule_results` and nothing else — no agent, no model calls, no cost. It answers on `/webhook/schedule-results`.

It deliberately does not return what the task actually said. This address carries no passcode; the agent, which does, is what reads the answer out.

No execution history is kept: several thousand identical successful polls a day would bury the list everyone actually reads.
